evidence_scope.method: Read installed code and execute selected pure functions extracted with AST in memory. No Hermes startup, config loader, client or model was invoked.
evidence_scope.transport_merge: The profile transport's one-level extra_body override merge was reproduced in memory between the extracted custom-profile and SDK merge functions; the complete transport/client was not executed.

profile_mechanism.environment_selection: Set HERMES_HOME to this profile's absolute location only in the new generator child process environment; do not mutate the parent or global environment.
profile_mechanism.profile_shape_reason: main._apply_profile_override trusts explicit HERMES_HOME with immediate parent named profiles, preventing active_profile from redirecting a bare invocation.
profile_mechanism.config_resolution: config.get_config_path resolves get_hermes_home()/config.yaml; get_env_path resolves the same home's .env.
profile_mechanism.provider_entry: providers.custom is explicitly exempt from built-in name shadowing and supports extra_body passthrough.
profile_mechanism.reasoning_scope: The installed custom profile emits reasoning_effort at top level; the proposed sampling extra_body contains no reasoning override.
profile_mechanism.local_route: Use the confirmed loopback Ollama OpenAI-compatible route on port 11434 with /v1. A nonsecret ollama API-key placeholder is sufficient; do not copy global credentials or .env.
profile_mechanism.preinitialization_scope: hermes config check is a local configuration-status check, not a wire/model validation. Startup logs and backups belong to the isolated private profile, outside public call archives.
profile_mechanism.execution_provenance_required: Bind the exact new profile config bytes SHA256, relative profile path, child environment selection and installed-code fingerprints to the fresh run. Do not reuse earlier calls, cached answers or manuscripts to claim sampling-profile execution.
